raw:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "be a BT ATM"
      role subject ?x
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be in"
      role subject ?x
      role location "Sighetu Marmatiei"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be near"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the train station"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
